sum: Vesicor Therapeutics Holdings, Inc., a biotechnology company, focuses on the development of p53-based cancer therapeutics in the United States. It develops engineered microvesicles for drug delivery, which is in pre-IND stage; and Ecm-RV/p53 for pancreatic and breast Cancer, which is in pre-IND stage. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in San Gabriel, California.
